results.title: Ghana vs Panama FIFA World Cup 2026 Preview: Everything you need to know | Goal.com Nigeria
highlights:
Comprehensive match preview of Ghana vs Panama at World Cup 2026. We talk tactics, team news and more.
[...]
Ghana vs Panama
[...]
Ghana kicks Group L off with a clash against Panama. The Black Stars' best showing in the World Cup was a quarter-final berth in 2010 in South Africa, which ended in heartbreaking fashion at the hands of Uruguay, who eventually vanquished them on penalties. Just ask Luis Suarez all about that. They've been eliminated at the group stage in each of their last two appearances in 2014 and 2022. Ghana are winless and without a clean sheet in their last seven outings.
[...]
Panama will be making their second-ever appearance on the grandest stage, following their debut in Russia eight years ago. They will be hunting for their first-ever World Cup match victory during the tournament in the Americas. Panama hasn't kept a shutout in any of their last seven matches either.
[...]

[...]
of the defensive
[...]
, known for his composure and aerial strength. Atalanta's Kamaldeen Sulemana is an electrifying creative spark, celebrated for his ability to break down defences with his pace and dribbling flair. Veteran Portuguese coach Queiroz was appointed on a short-term contract in April to lead the team through the travails of the World Cup.
[...]
Ghana head coach Carlos Queiroz has not confirmed a probable starting lineup ahead of the Group L opener, and no injury or suspension concerns have been officially listed for the Black Stars at this stage. Updates are expected closer to kick-off as the squad finalises preparations in Toronto.
[...]
Ghana arrive in Toronto off the back of a mixed run of results. Across their last five matches, the Black Stars recorded one draw and four defeats, conceding 11 goals and scoring four. Their most recent outing ended in a 1-1 draw with Wales on June 2, a result that at least arrested a run of three straight losses. Those defeats included a 2-0 reverse against Mexico, a 2-1 loss to Germany, and a heavy 5-1 defeat to Austria in March.
[...]
Panama's recent form is more varied. In five preparatory matches, Los Canaleros claimed two wins, two draws, and one defeat. Their last outing was a 1-1 stalemate with Bosnia and Herzegovina on June 6, while a 4-2 win over the Dominican Republic two days earlier showed their attacking capabilities. The one blemish was a 6-2 thrashing by Brazil on May 31, though wins over South Africa in March — including a 1-2 away victory — gave Christiansen's side a positive foundation heading into the tournament.
[...]
In Group L, Ghana currently occupy third place while Panama sit fourth, with both sides yet to play their opening fixture of the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

Ghana are drawn in Group L of the 2026 FIFA World Cup alongside England, Croatia and Panama. For all our World Cup 2026 predictions and analysis visit LeagueLane.
[...]
Queiroz uses a 4-2-3-1 with Partey and Elisha Owusu as the double pivot. The defensive structure is organised and compact. In attack, Semenyo and Inaki Williams operate from wide positions and Jordan Ayew plays as the central forward or drops into the number ten role depending on the game. Kamaldeen Sulemana and Fatawu Issahaku provide pace and directness from the bench. Queiroz has built his Ghana setup around defensive solidity first. He does not trust a high defensive line and he does not want Ghana to be exposed on the counter. Against England and Croatia that approach makes sense. Against Panama in the opener, it creates risk if Ghana are too passive in the first 30 minutes.

## LeagueLane Verdict
[...]
Ghana’s World Cup depends on the Panama opener. Win it and they arrive at the England game with confidence and a platform to push for second place. Lose it or draw and the pressure builds immediately for a new manager with limited time to prepare.
[...]
Queiroz is experienced enough to set up Ghana to be hard to beat in every game. Whether he has had enough time to make them difficult to beat and dangerous going forward simultaneously is the question that defines their tournament.
[...]
The Croatia game on June 27 in Philadelphia is the one that could define second place in Group L. If both teams arrive needing a result, Semenyo and Williams against Croatia’s ageing defensive line is the matchup Ghana will be building toward. Modric at 40 is a different defensive challenge to Modric at 33. Ghana can exploit the spaces Dalic’s system leaves behind.
[...]
For a betting angle, Semenyo to score in the tournament at odds that reflect his new-signing status at City is the play. He is in outstanding form, arrives motivated and faces Panama and Croatia in matches where he will have the space to express himself. Ghana to beat Panama and qualify for the knockout rounds as a third-place team is not an unreasonable ambition at the right price.

highlights:
Ghana World Cup 2026 Preview: Odds, Picks, Players to Watch & Predictions
[...]
Ghana will make their fifth appearance at the FIFA World Cup this summer. The 2026 edition will be 20 years since the Black Stars qualified for the global showpiece for the first time. Despite reaching the quarter-finals in 2010, Ghana have not past the group stages since and will hope to break that trend in USA, Canada and Mexico.
[...]
## ✅ What is the best bet for Ghana at the World Cup 2026?
[...]
The expanded 48-team format works in Ghana's favour here. With the best 3rd-place finishers having the chance of qualifying for the knockout round, Black Stars will fancy their chances even if they don’t finish top two. That safety net makes this one of the more straightforward wagers.
[...]
Ghana will fancy their chances against both Panama and Croatia, and new coach Carlos Queiroz brings considerable experience and hunger to the role. With in-form players like Antoine Semenyo providing a real threat going forward, the Black Stars have the quality to make their presence felt.
[...]
## 🌍 How did Ghana qualify for the 2026 World Cup?
[...]
Drawn in CAF Group I alongside Mali, Madagascar, Comoros, Central African Republic and Chad, Ghana topped the standings with 25 points from a possible 30, scoring 23 goals and conceding just six across their 10 matches.
[...]
It was a dominant campaign from start to finish, with a 5-0 thrashing of Chad among the standout results. Jordan Ayew finished as Ghana's leading scorer with seven goals, while Mohammed Kudus scored the goal that officially sealed qualification.
[...]
Ghana finished five points clear of 2nd-placed Madagascar, confirming their place at football's biggest stage for the fifth time in their history.
[...]
#### What are Ghana's odds to win the World Cup 2026?
[...]
Ghana are not fancied by the bookmakers and come into the tournament at 500/1.
[...]
#### Can Ghana win the World Cup 2026?
[...]
They've got the talent to cause problems, they always have the talent, but since 2010 we've only seen it in flashes. Who knows, a win over Panama could see them through and they have a high ceiling despite looking unconvincing in recent years, including failing to qualify for the last AFCON.

results.title: Ghana World Cup 2026 Group L Preview: Black Stars Face England, Croatia and Panama Without Kudus - Nigerian Matchday
highlights:
preview and betting
[...]
Ghana’s Group L schedule is as follows. First, Ghana vs Panama on Wednesday, June 17 in Toronto (kick-off 7:00 PM ET). This is the game Ghana must win. Then England vs Ghana on Tuesday, June 23 at Gillette Stadium (4:00 PM ET) — their hardest test. Finally, Croatia vs Ghana on Saturday, June 27 at Lincoln Financial Field (5:00 PM ET) — potentially a must-win if results have not gone to plan.
[...]
The route to the round of 16 runs through beating Panama and securing at least one point from the England and Croatia games. With the expanded 48-team format allowing third-placed finishers to progress, even a point or two could be enough. For the full guide to how the format works, check our World Cup 2026 new format and betting edges guide.
[...]
Ghana vs Panama (June 17, Toronto) is Ghana’s most winnable fixture. Panama reached the World Cup as relative underdogs and have limited depth beyond their first XI. Ghana should be capable of winning this match if they apply their quality from the first whistle. Ghana to win at around 1.85-2.00 represents value. Both teams to score — NO at around 1.60 also appeals, given Ghana’s defensive discipline under Queiroz and Panama’s limited attacking threat.
[...]
For England vs Ghana (June 23), England are strong favourites. However, Ghana have historically been competitive against major European nations and with the right performance could steal a draw. Ghana +1.5 on the Asian handicap is the angle here — likely priced around 1.50-1.60 and reducing risk significantly. Ghana to score at least one goal (YES) also has appeal at around 1.55.
[...]
Croatia vs Ghana (June 27) could be the pivotal final group game. With both teams potentially needing a result, this match may be the most intense of Ghana’s campaign. The draw is worth considering given the mutual need for a result. Match draw at around 3.00 could provide tournament-long value.
[...]
Ghana’s path to the round of 16 is possible but demanding. Beat Panama, take something from Croatia, and the expanded format’s third-place qualification route may be enough — even with a defeat to England in between. The Kudus absence is a genuine problem at a tournament level. However, Queiroz has built a resilient, experienced squad that knows how to defend and win collective battles.
[...]
Prediction: Ghana beat Panama, lose to England, and draw with Croatia. That leaves them on four points — enough to advance as a strong third-place side given the rest of the African group results. The Black Stars make it to the knockout rounds by the narrowest of margins. Stay across all the match previews and tips on our today’s free betting tips page throughout the tournament.
